rationale: learned_primal_dual-claude-agentic: lpd_iters=5, lpd_hidden=48, lpd_n_primal=5, lpd_n_dual=5, lpd_share_weights=False, lr=0.0007, lr_schedule=cosine, epochs=6, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-6 search-20260619-01: ONE knob = lpd_iters 3 -> 5 (UNROLL DEPTH), the LPD-DEFINING lever and the only remaining axis that directly tests the structural hypothesis. BASE_ITER=4 (best-SSIM config: lr=7e-4 cosine, lpd_hidden=48, n_primal=5, n_dual=5, batch=1, val_chunk=1, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). PRIOR ARC (ALL hr=0): SSIM 0.84271(it1 iters5/ep6/lr5e-4) -> 0.863635(it2) -> 0.885115(it3) -> 0.898033(it4 BEST, iters3/ep10/lr7e-4) -> 0.88446(it5 train_n300/ep7, epochs-cut-confounded but LOWEST RMSE 1.139e-3 yet STILL hr0). hr pinned at the LD-FBP floor the ENTIRE arc. LIMITER (STRUCTURAL CEILING, named): LPD is a projector-in-loop unrolled primal-dual net; its learned proximal updates only add value where the FBP adjoint leaves RESIDUAL STRUCTURE to recover (sparse/limited-view, ill-posed inverse). On DENSE 2304-view Mayo the LD-FBP is NEAR-COMPLETE (2304 views >> Nyquist; well-conditioned operator), so there is NO ill-posedness headroom for the unrolled updates to exploit -> LPD sharpens structure (rising SSIM) but cannot push RMSE below the already-near-optimal LD-FBP -> hr=0 regardless of capacity/epochs/lr/data. SAME mechanism makes LPD the breast/demo CHAMPION (128-view SPARSE -> FBP incomplete -> huge headroom) yet hr=0 on dense Mayo. iter-5 already FALSIFIED the data lever (train_n 200->300 fell to 0.88446). REMAINING UNTRIED AXIS = unroll DEPTH itself: lpd_iters 3->5 doubles-ish the learned primal-dual correction steps. If Mayo had ANY FBP-incompleteness headroom, deeper unrolling (the thing that makes LPD an unrolled net, not a U-Net) is exactly where it would surface. BUDGET MATH vs 1200s: iters=5 raises per-sample projector fwd+adj cost ~5/3x vs iters=3, so epochs traded 10->6 AND train_n 300->200 to hold the wall. EMPIRICALLY CONFIRMED FIT: iter-1 ran iters5/ep6/tn200 = 1149.5s = 19.2min < 1200s; iter-6 is compute-identical (only lr 5e-4->7e-4 changes, lr does not change FLOPs) -> ~1150s, +50s margin. ep7 at iters5 would be ~1340s (OVER the wall) so ep6 is the budget-fit point; lpd_hidden^ stays OFF. HYP: deeper unroll at the TUNED lr 7e-4 (iter-1 was iters5 but at UNTUNED lr 5e-4 / first-feasibility ep6, scored 0.84271) extracts more FBP-residual correction; predict SSIM ~0.86-0.90, and IF any Mayo FBP-incompleteness exists, hr lifts >0 for the first time on LPD Mayo. FALSIFIER: hr stays 0.000 (and SSIM <= 0.898 since ep6 under-trains vs iter-4 ep10) => deeper unrolling does NOT help => DEFINITIVE structural ceiling: dense 2304-view LD-FBP is near-complete, LPD has no ill-posedness to exploit, FBP-bounded regardless of unroll depth. The path now DOCUMENTS the ceiling toward iter-20.
